construction.head: skill
construction.ball_in_play: call code X, D or E with a trajectory in ground_ball, line_drive, fly_ball, popup; bunts left out
construction.spray: centre line = median coordX of the balls fielded by the centre fielder in the (sport, season); a switch hitter bats opposite the pitcher's hand
construction.norm: z inside the (sport, season) pool of every player with at least 50 of the denominator (at least 30 players)
construction.shrink: D / (D + K) on the total denominator
construction.as_of: efv_dataset._milb_features rule (season Y readable from 1 October of Y)

park.effect: on-base share of plate appearances in the club's home games minus its road games, shrunk n / (n + 2000) with n the smaller count
park.correction: PA-weighted mean effect over the parks of the player's own plate appearances at the MiLB block's season and level, times pa / (pa + 50)

w_star_dev.convention: the k-th largest W3 on the rows, k = the number of six-season contributors; development convention on the fwar label, re-derived by EV-05 on the frozen label
